resources.string: Enter your %1$s client ID first (Settings → Sign-in clients).
Install a web browser to sign in.
The saved sign-in data is not available. Sign in again.
The sign-in took too long. Try again.
You did not give access in the browser. Try again.
The sign-in failed (%1$s). Try again.
Plico did not get access to your mail. Sign in again and allow access to mail.
The answer from %1$s was not complete. Try again.
%1$s stopped the access of Plico to this account. Sign in again.
Google does not accept your OAuth client ID. Make sure that it is an Android client for the package name and signing SHA-1 of this app.
Google does not know this app. In your Google Cloud project, add an Android OAuth client for the package name and signing SHA-1 of this app. Or use an app password.
Google must get your permission again. Sign in again.
Plico cannot use the Google account on this phone. Choose the account again, or use an app password.
Gmail does not show All Mail to IMAP. In Gmail on the web, go to Settings → Labels and turn on \"Show in IMAP\" for All Mail.
Gmail does not show Trash to IMAP, so Delete is off. To turn it on, go to Gmail Settings → Labels and turn on \"Show in IMAP\" for Trash.
Gmail does not show Spam to IMAP, so Spam is off. To turn it on, go to Gmail Settings → Labels and turn on \"Show in IMAP\" for Spam.
Microsoft does not accept your client ID. Make sure that the redirect URI %1$s is under Mobile and desktop applications.
Microsoft did not accept your client ID for this account. Make sure that the client ID is correct. The account types must be \"Any Entra ID tenant and personal Microsoft accounts\".
An administrator must approve Plico for this account. Ask the administrator of your organization.
Microsoft did not open the mailbox. In Outlook.com, turn on IMAP for devices and apps. Make sure that you signed in with the main address of the account.
Microsoft does not let apps send mail from this account. Plico can receive mail, but it cannot send it. The administrator of the account can turn on SMTP AUTH.
Another app on this phone can receive the sign-in answer for Plico. Remove that app, then try again.
The server does not accept a password sign-in that Plico can use.
Plico cannot use this sign-in method with this server. Remove this account and add it again.
This server is a Gmail server. Remove this account and add it again.

plurals.name: account_note_no_idle
plurals.item: This server cannot tell Plico about new mail immediately. Plico checks for new mail every %d minute. You can change this in the account settings.
This server cannot tell Plico about new mail immediately. Plico checks for new mail every %d minutes. You can change this in the account settings.
